title: Add runtime effect projections for SRD feature records
description:
Finding source:
- Codex readiness review reported 69 feature records still prose-only or mechanically shallow.
- ChatGPT noted feature choice modeling does not imply runtime feature effects are deterministic.
- Examples include effects like Barbarian Unarmored Defense and other class/subclass features that affect AC, resources, damage, movement, senses, resistances, checks, saves, or spellcasting.

Acceptance criteria:
- Inventory all feature records with runtime gameplay effects missing from data.mechanics/projection.
- Preserve existing structured character-creation/level-up choice modeling.
- Add projections for AC formulas, usage resources, damage/bonus effects, movement/senses, resistances/immunities, save/check modifiers, spellcasting/runtime effects, and other high-impact categories.
- Create implementation child beads if the inventory is too broad.
close_reason: Review findings addressed in PR #398 commit 3cb4f36: classifier fixes (Persistent Rage/Danger Sense/Grappler + Wild Shape/Channel Divinity), complete projections (shield eligibility, Reckless constraint split, Aura minimum/range, Smite max+rider, Brutal Critical & Extra Attack progressions, structured Stonecunning, weaponAttacksMagical scope), unified acFormula contract + per-kind payload validators, exact feature membership gates + committed-pack depth assertions. CI green (14/14); PR open for re-review.
